## Summary

- Rewrite docs index links to use `../docs/...` targets so Quartz published slugs stay under `/docs/...` instead of `/overview/...`.
- Add a docs-index link test that checks each internal index link stays under the docs namespace and points at an existing source file.

## Verification

- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/docs-index-links.test.js`
- `git diff --check -- .agent/docs/README.md`
- `git diff --no-index --check /dev/null .agent/src/__tests__/docs-index-links.test.ts`

Closes #310

Part of #314

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #324 fixes issue #310, a child task in the #314 batch of small fixes.
- The docs index previously used source-valid relative links such as `overview/...`, which Quartz published as root-level `/overview/...` links instead of `/docs/overview/...`.
- The PR updates the index links in [`.agent/docs/README.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/a433aaa2b88316f75238c2768010784910a6e045/.agent/docs/README.md) to use `../docs/...` targets.
- It also adds [`.agent/src/__tests__/docs-index-links.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/a433aaa2b88316f75238c2768010784910a6e045/.agent/src/__tests__/docs-index-links.test.ts), which checks that docs-index links publish under `/docs/...` and still resolve to existing source files.

@sepo-agent /answer is the fix here general? That also makes the doc readable and linkable in the current repo

Yes, general for the docs index scope.

It is not just fixing the one `overview/what-is...` link. PR #324 changes every internal link in [`.agent/docs/README.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/a433aaa2b88316f75238c2768010784910a6e045/.agent/docs/README.md) to the same `../docs/...` pattern, and the added test in [`.agent/src/__tests__/docs-index-links.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/a433aaa2b88316f75238c2768010784910a6e045/.agent/src/__tests__/docs-index-links.test.ts) enforces that future index links both:

- publish under the `/docs/...` namespace for Quartz
- still resolve to an existing source file under `.agent/docs`

It also remains readable/linkable in the current repo. From `.agent/docs/README.md`, a link like `../docs/overview/quick-start.md` normalizes back to `.agent/docs/overview/quick-start.md`, so GitHub/local Markdown should still navigate correctly.

The limitation: this is general for `.agent/docs/README.md` as the docs index, not a repo-wide rewrite for every cross-link in every docs page. A global guarantee would need either a publisher-level rewrite or a broader `.agent/docs/**/*.md` link test.
